services.name: Blotato Engine
services.tagline: Unified social API, MCP server and full web console for 9 platforms. Self-hosted, unlimited posts, zero subscription.
services.summary: Blotato sells a unified social media API and MCP server for $29/mo. This engine reproduces the whole surface — publishing, scheduling, comments, DMs, keyword automations, analytics, visual generation and source repurposing — across 38 REST endpoints and 17 MCP tools, plus a nine-screen web console. Same request shapes, same tool names, no per-seat billing and no post caps.

features.title: Publishing
features.body: One POST /v2/posts targets any connected account. The connector registry resolves the platform adapter.

features.title: Scheduling
features.body: ISO-8601 scheduling, background dispatcher and recurring weekly slots per account.

features.title: Comments and DMs
features.body: Read comments, reply publicly, list DM threads and send messages.

features.title: Automations
features.body: Keyword triggers, public reply variants, DMs, gates and webhooks.

features.title: Analytics
features.body: Snapshots, aggregate totals, engagement rates and top-post rankings.

features.title: Visuals
features.body: Six Pillow templates render quote cards, tweet cards, carousels and infographics.

features.title: Sources
features.body: Extract from YouTube, articles, PDFs, X posts or text, then repurpose drafts.

features.title: Console
features.body: Dashboard, composer, queue, inbox, automations, visuals, sources, analytics and settings.

services.name: Lead Engine
services.tagline: Prospect search and contact enrichment: work emails, provider-sourced personal emails and phone numbers.
services.summary: Self-hosted prospecting and enrichment workspace inspired by SalesQL. Search by role, company, industry, location and headcount; reveal work email for one credit only when found; process LinkedIn URL and CSV enrichment jobs; verify emails; organize folders; run simulated campaigns with open/click tracking; connect AI agents using MCP. Real provider-backed details require your own API keys. Without one, the system can generate a work-email candidate from a public company domain and check MX, but never invents a personal email or phone.
highlights: Prospector filters and natural-language filter parsing; searches cost 0 credits
One credit per successful email reveal; no result means no charge
Work email candidates use ranked patterns and MX checks
Direct email and phone are returned only by configured providers
LinkedIn URL and CSV enrichment jobs, folders and verifier
Campaign sequences and tracking; send simulation by default
Six MCP tools and a nine-screen UI

features.title: Prospector
features.body: Filter by title, company, industry, location, seniority and headcount. Searching never uses credits.

features.title: Contact reveal
features.body: Reveals work email confidence/status. One credit only when an email is found. Unavailable data is not fabricated.

features.title: LinkedIn URL enrichment
features.body: Parse profile URLs and enrich via configured Hunter, Apollo or PDL providers. Does not scrape LinkedIn or bypass sign-in/anti-bot controls.

features.title: Bulk CSV enrichment
features.body: Upload LinkedIn URLs, names/company, or email addresses. Poll jobs and download enriched CSV.

features.title: Email verifier
features.body: Syntax, role account, MX and optional SMTP checks. SMTP probe is off by default.

features.title: Folders and campaigns
features.body: Save contacts in lists. Build sequences and track opens/clicks. Sends are simulated unless SMTP is explicitly configured.

features.title: MCP and API
features.body: Search, reveal, enrich, verify, folders and credits via MCP/API.

ui.intro: Local workspace UI: prospect search, enrichment, lists, verifier, campaigns and API/MCP settings.

install.title: Run enrichment tests
install.desc: Uses real DNS. Provider APIs optional.

usage.title: Search prospects
usage.desc: No credits are spent on search.
usage.code: curl -X POST http://localhost:8500/api/search -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"filters":{"title":"Head of Talent","industry":"Fintech","location":"London"},"pageSize":20}'

usage.title: Submit LinkedIn URL enrichment
usage.desc: Real contact data requires a provider API key. LinkedIn scraping is not performed.
usage.code: curl -X POST http://localhost:8500/api/enrich/linkedin -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"urls":["https://www.linkedin.com/in/example-person"],"companyHint":"Example Inc"}'

endpoints.desc: Reveal and conditionally charge one credit
Simulated send; no email by default

monetization.detail: 50 monthly reveal credits, 1 seat, 100 campaign recipients.
2,000 credits and CSV enrichment up to 1,000 rows.

notes: This is an independent clean-room tool. It does not scrape LinkedIn or bypass login/rate limits. Enrich from user-supplied URLs through licensed APIs and domain-based work-email checks.
Without HUNTER_API_KEY, APOLLO_API_KEY or PDL_API_KEY, results are limited to generated work-email candidates and MX checks. No personal email or phone is invented.
Seeded sample contacts are fictional demo records, not real people.
SMTP probing is off by default. Campaign sends are simulated by default; configure SMTP only with consent and a lawful basis.
Development login: admin@leadengine.local / leadengine123. Change it before deployment and never expose the dev server publicly.

faq.q: Can it get email and phone from a LinkedIn link?
faq.a: It parses profile URLs and enriches through configured Hunter, Apollo or PDL APIs. Without provider keys it can generate work-email candidates from name/domain and check MX. It never scrapes LinkedIn or invents a direct email/phone.
No. Seed records are fictional demo data.
No by default. Sends are simulated. SMTP is an explicit opt-in.
No. Only a reveal that returns at least one email costs one credit.
